title: Researcher/contributor identifier (research candidate)
reason:
Depth: shallow. Confidence medium in scope distinction; no canonical mapping. Researcher scope does not identify every author/person; provenance/trusted assertions matter.

Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: Source-local person, customer, employee, supplier, store and business-entity IDs have no cross-demo or real-world identity. Customer/supplier/employer/operator are roles; organisation, legal entity, site and registration differ. A native PK/FK supports only its declared source relationship. Alternate unique names/GUIDs are source-scoped; names are not LEI/ROR/ORCID or a portable person key. Retain the specific research distinction from this candidate. Evidence gap: final concept boundaries/operational source scope remain unproven; a source implementation and potential overlap with canonical or related research must be resolved before promotion.
practical_value: Researcher scope does not identify every author/person; provenance/trusted assertions matter.
showcase_value: Research affiliation/output graph or contact/network explanation when portable keys actually exist.
